content.message: CONGRATS!! You have WON a FREE tablet 🎉 Claim in 5 mins befor it expires: prize-claim.co/win

do.text: The site asked for your name and home address. Now a stranger knows where you live.

ignore.text: You stayed safe, but the next day another prize text arrives...

tell.text: Mum blocked the number and reported it as spam. Scam stopped!

buddy.intro: Ooh, a new text message just came in!

do.text: Uh oh! Let's see what went wrong.

ignore.text: Safe for now… but the scam is still out there.

tell.text: Great call! Telling a grown-up stopped it!

stop.text: This timer was trying to rush you, so you wouldn't stop and think.

check.text: You never entered a contest! You can't win something you didn't enter.
Spelling mistake: 'befor'. Real companies check their spelling.
This is a strange link from someone you don't know.

recap.tell: Show a parent and say: 'I got this text and I'm not sure about it.'
